note: an unestablished presence stops being refused and falls through to the value check — the softening a future edit is most likely to make, because 'could not read it' reads like a lesser problem than 'it is not there'
the presence test inverted: a present directory is refused and an absent one passes
the path-shape rule removed, so a UNC declaration is dispatched against
the drive letter stops having to be a letter
the length floor lowered by one, so a bare drive spec reaches the separator test
